Not measured

Items here mean “cannot be known from this run”, not “does not exist”.

  • Categories with no natural vitality related queries 3categories — magnesium cream · maca · collagen
  • Alias rules — product and line names roll up to the parent brand; spacing variants and common typos count as the same brand.
  • The name axis is Search share among brands — only related queries containing a brand name (incl. aliases) are kept; the denominator is the summed volume of own + competitor brand queries (unlike QueryFinder topic totals, generic queries are excluded). Leading / Contested / Trailing follow the 2× rule between us and the #1 brand. Unowned are categories where the brand-search ratio (brand queries ÷ (brand queries + head term)) is under 10% or brand queries total under 1,000/yr — people search them without brands.
  • The path axis is the unique count of brand queries appearing across all 300 path_finder paths — the same number you get by filtering the ListeningMind Path View keyword list by brand name. “First seen” is the step after the seed where it first appears. A brand query repeated across paths counts once. Verdict uses the 2× rule; if both sides have fewer than 3, it is “None”.
  • Need verdicts count how many brand queries appear on the 300 search paths of each situation query — branded situation searches (“brand + situation + category”) barely exist, so they are not used.
Limits
  1. Needs and competitors were selected by LLM judgment — brand words were split off from query prefixes and only situation / use / function words kept. The selection table is in the work/curate.json.
  2. Need verdicts only use paths starting from one situation query; journeys of people who searched the same situation in other words are not included.

Not measured

Items here mean “cannot be known from this run”, not “does not exist”.

  • Categories with no natural vitality related queries 3categories — magnesium cream · maca · collagen
  • Alias rules — product and line names roll up to the parent brand; spacing variants and common typos count as the same brand.
  • The name axis is Search share among brands — only related queries containing a brand name (incl. aliases) are kept; the denominator is the summed volume of own + competitor brand queries (unlike QueryFinder topic totals, generic queries are excluded). Leading / Contested / Trailing follow the 2× rule between us and the #1 brand. Unowned are categories where the brand-search ratio (brand queries ÷ (brand queries + head term)) is under 10% or brand queries total under 1,000/yr — people search them without brands.
  • The path axis is the unique count of brand queries appearing across all 300 path_finder paths — the same number you get by filtering the ListeningMind Path View keyword list by brand name. “First seen” is the step after the seed where it first appears. A brand query repeated across paths counts once. Verdict uses the 2× rule; if both sides have fewer than 3, it is “None”.
  • Need verdicts count how many brand queries appear on the 300 search paths of each situation query — branded situation searches (“brand + situation + category”) barely exist, so they are not used.
Limits
  1. Needs and competitors were selected by LLM judgment — brand words were split off from query prefixes and only situation / use / function words kept. The selection table is in the work/curate.json.
  2. Need verdicts only use paths starting from one situation query; journeys of people who searched the same situation in other words are not included.
